meta.description: Complete 3x3 F2L case list for CFOP method
notes: Standard F2L (cases 1-41): assumes target slot is the front-right slot and is empty
Advanced F2L (AF2L 1-54): covers cases where corner or edge is trapped in another slot
Each case includes: setup scramble (to reproduce the case from solved state), category, description, and top algorithms
Slot variants (FR/FL/BL/BR) indicate the target slot for which the alg is written
For non-FR slots, use y rotations or the slot-specific alg listed
Sources: SpeedCubeDB, CubeSkills (Feliks Zemdegs / Andy Klise PDF)
